summary:
Heap out-of-bounds write in the native PNG/APNG encoder when writing a
crafted eXIf chunk (add_exif_profile_size() underestimates the sanitized
IFD size). The eXIf-writing code does not exist in this source:
libavcodec/pngenc.c at n7.1.5 (and on the release/7.1 branch) has no
EXIF/IFD handling at all; it was added in the 8.x series, which is why
the CVE range reads "through 8.1.2". Upstream fix b506fafe cannot apply
here because the code it patches is absent.
Refs:
  - https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-66040
  - https://code.ffmpeg.org/FFmpeg/FFmpeg/commit/b506fafec9a19fcbc2be5271875fd4a63d6615bc
details: |
  If this spec is ever bumped to a version whose pngenc.c writes eXIf
  chunks (8.1+), this entry MUST be re-evaluated and converted into a
  real PATCH_TYPE_UPSTREAM_PATCH entry.
